'''LS-21'''<ref name="Kindred" /> was a [[human]]<ref name="USW" /> [[Gender|female]] [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] who [[pilot]]ed a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE/sa bomber]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]. LS-21 and another bomber were ordered by [[Governor of the Lothal sector]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] to bomb a mountain range on Lothal when [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] fled deeper into the rocks.<ref name="Kindred" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
LS-21 first appeared in "[[Kindred]]," the seventh episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|fourth season]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. She was voiced by [[Vanessa Marshall]], who also voices [[Hera Syndulla]].<ref name="Kindred" />
